name: Four Seasons Resort Mallorca at Formentor
positioning: Beachfront resort at the northern tip of Mallorca on the Cap de Formentor peninsula, with 110 rooms and suites, a working vineyard and direct access to a 1 kilometre beach
best_for: Travelers who want a beach resort at Mallorca's northernmost point
Families, with a complimentary Kids For All Seasons program

facts.text: Four Seasons Resort Mallorca at Formentor opened in August 2024.
The Resort has 110 guest rooms and suites.
All guest rooms and suites have sea-facing terraces.
Four Seasons is at the island's northernmost point, on the peninsula known as Cap de Formentor.
The Resort is a 60-minute drive from Palma de Mallorca Airport.
The Resort has direct access to a 1 kilometre (.6-mile) beach.
Shima is the signature restaurant, serving Nikkei cuisine, a fusion of Japanese and Peruvian flavours.
Mel is a Mediterranean restaurant open from breakfast to late night.
Llum i Sal is the beach restaurant, on Playa de Formentor.
The Resort has a working vineyard.
The Fitness Centre is open 24 hours.
The Resort was originally opened in 1929.

highlights.text: Formentor Beach is named a Blue Flag beach for its high environmental standards.
The Kids For All Seasons program is complimentary.
The Garden-View Suite with Plunge Pool has an oversized terrace with a plunge pool.
The Resort has a private boat dock.

considerations.text: Vehicle access to the Formentor Peninsula is restricted daily from 10:00 am to 10:00 pm during the high season (May 15 to October 18).
Guests arriving by car need advance authorization to access the road leading to the Resort.
Non-motorized water sports at the beach are available for an additional fee.
WhataHotel notes the remote location requires planning for off-property dining.

perks.text: With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, breakfast for two is free daily.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get a priority upgrade if available at check-in.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get a $100 hotel credit.
WhataHotel special offers can be combined with the exclusive perks.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get free Wi-Fi access.
